caption: The drawing features a single object, a wooden butter churn, set against a plain, light beige background. The churn has a conical, slightly tapered cylindrical shape and is constructed from vertical wooden staves, which are held together by four black metal bands spaced at intervals along its height. The wood texture is visible, and the color is a natural, mid-tone brown, with some subtle shading indicating the curvature and grain of the wood. At the top of the churn is a round, flat wooden lid with a central hole, through which a straight, cylindrical wooden handle passes vertically upward. The handle is long, extends well above the churn, and has a small round hole near its top end. No other objects or colors are present in the drawing.
title: Handmade Churn
